To address the upcoming trends in early vulnerabilities detection, a standard predictive model of DDoS attacks needs to be implemented. In this paper we propose a robust pipeline for DDoS classification and the performance of the models are calculated against the metrics such as precision, recall and f1-scores. After evaluating various machine learning models, the XGboost algorithm works well on our data set with an accuracy score of 99% outperforming other models.

articleTitle: Carbon Capture, Utilization and Storage (CCUS) - The Energy source of the future
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)

authors.preferredName: D. M. Mary Synthia Regis Prabha

abstract: Transformation of global energy sector from fossil fuel based energy production and consumption to renewable energy sources has lead to energy transition. This energy transition also aims to reduce the green house gases through various forms of decarbonization. Fossil fuels are excellent fuels and cannot be replaced immediately because of their incredible energy density, requiring no innovation to collect, store and transform into energy and the well-established structures which made the industrial revolution possible. Hence to achieve net carbon zero condition across the globe, the emitted CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> from the fossil fuel plants is collected, stored and is either used in applications requiring CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> as the raw material or can be permanently sequestrated in CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> storage sites utilizing Carbon Capture, Utilization and Storage (CCUS) technology. The captured CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> is used for producing further energy thus improving the hydrogen economy and also is utilized for Enhanced Oil Recovery (EOR) which makes this CCUS technology the energy source of the future.

articleTitle: Implementation of Machine learning Algorithms to Identify Freshness of Fruits
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The main goal of the study is to determine which algorithm, using classic machine learning and deep learning models, accurately predicts photos when given by the user. In the first part of the study, we will see how machine learning applications and how they are used in modern life. The second half of the study will explain the various parameters that have been projected by our study and how well the designs are performing with the given set of data. Finally, deep learning techniques showed better accuracy with lower false positive rates in comparison to machine learning models. Within the food business, computerised classification of fruit freshness plays a significant role. Fruit degradation must be discovered at every stage of the process, from manufacture to consumption. Traditional procedures for identifying fruit deterioration are modest, difficult, subjective, and time consuming, necessitating the introduction of precise automatic technologies that may be used for industrial reasons. This study looks at a dataset of three distinct fruits to distinguish between fresh and rotting fruits. Conventional methods like machines and various types of deep learning are used in a typical vision-based system. The utmost realisation rates are usually achieved particularly when we use convolutional neural networks-cantered elements and deep learning models after testing the model for numerous tentative layouts, including both binary and multi-class classification tasks.

articleTitle: A Proposed Work for Reduction Of Power In Level Shifter
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The growing urge of VLSI technology to exhibit low power and high speed operating devices has always led to the need of devices that operate at multiple voltage domains. In order to incorporate this multiple voltage devices on a single VLSI chip, the level shifter forms an essential circuit. This power domain issue is more prominent in the devices exhibiting sub-threshold operations. Thus designing a level shifter plays a crucial role especially in the design of complex circuits that have multi-voltage domains. The major challenges in the design of level shifters are low power dissipation, transistor count, high performance and robustness. This paper focuses on an attempt to change the circuit in order to get low power dissipation. Multiple Threshold Level Shifter (MTLS) that incorporates transistors with different threshold voltages within the circuit. Compared to the existing Differential cascode voltage switch (DCVS) logic, the power delay product (PDP) of MTLS is found to be efficient. Thus MTLS could be used to cascade complex circuits.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning Algorithms for Photovoltaic Degradation Rate Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Solar energy is the most versatile, harmless, and non-exhaustive energy present in nature because of this, the number of photovoltaic modules that have been integrated into the electrical grid is increasing every day. As a result, reliable forecasting of falling power output over the period of time is required for an acceptable return on investment made for these interactions, to estimate the power delivered to the power system by these photovoltaic modules, photovoltaic degradation rates must be known. In this study degradation rates of photovoltaic modules are estimated using the application of nine machine learning models and the effectiveness of these models is compared in order to determine which model is most efficient. All the models are tested on various evaluation metrics like mean absolute error, root mean squared error, and mean percentage error for an unbiased evaluation, and the run time of these models is also calculated and compared to determine the overall efficiency of the models.

articleTitle: The Information Technology and Employee Performance in the Indian Telecom Industry
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The study aims to analyze the impact of information technology on the performance of the employees working in the telecom sector. This descriptive study used regression for identifying the relationships of the variables. Data was collected from 305 respondents through the online questionnaire. After reviewing the existing literature, the data is analyzed using the t-test, Fisher's test, and the coefficient of determination. It was found through the results of regression analysis, that information technology has a significant positive impact on the performance of the employees working in the telecom sector. Therefore, the hypothesis is been accepted for the study. It is also proven by administering simulation testing. In addition to this, this study also throws light on the benefits and the contributions of technology to improving employee performance.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review on Finite Control Set Model Predictive Control: Trends and Prospects
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: This article focuses on the recent developments and trends in predictive control techniques for power electronics. Among them, Finite Control Set Model Predictive Control (FCS-MPC) is an excellent choice for controlling the power converters. Nonlinearities and system constraints can be addressed with this promising control approach. It can address multiple variable systems and exhibits dynamic response. It does, however, impose a significant computational burden. Its use in UPS, matrix converters, active filters, and adjustable speed drives, as well as cost function selection and weighting factor approximation, are all detailed, This paper also summarizes the advancements in the implementation technology of FCS-MPC. The FCS-MPC strategy of inverter for UPS application is simulated and results are shown.

articleTitle: Data Driven Modelling and Prediction Of Rainfall
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)

authors.preferredName: Mary Synthia Regis Prabha D M

abstract: The prediction of weather and is difficult because these phenomena are highly non-linear and complicated phenomena. Technology based on artificial intelligence enables knowledge processing and is utilised in predicting. Synthetic neural network (ANN) has emerged as an alluring substitute for conventional statistical techniques for anticipating the behaviour of nonlinear systems The purpose of this paper is to prevent tools to model and predict rainfall behavior form past observations based on past observation. There are two fundamentally different approaches that are used in the paper to develop a model, both based on statistical methods based on ANNs. The prediction efficiency was evaluated based on 115years of mean annual rainfall between 1901and 2015.

articleTitle: Teach less and Practice more: Flipped Learning for Nursing Education
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: It is essential that students and teachers work together to acquire even the most basic nursing care skills to the full extent of the Nursing Process. The nursing procedure is not something that can be learnt in a single day by any student. There were various difficulties for both learners and mentors during the COVID-19 outbreak when e-learning was used as a mode of instruction. This project was designed to efficiently address learning needs during a pandemic. In this study, baccalaureate nursing students were taught the nursing process using a flipped classroom methodology with the goal of developing knowledge and skill in the nursing process.To teach the nursing process during the covid-19 pandemic; A Flipped learning program was planned with 4 online modules to teach the nursing process. To see the effectiveness one group posttest only design was adopted for 36 students selected by consecutive sampling. The whole program was planned with an integrated pedagogy in pre-classroom, during the classroom, and post-classroom activities to attain the objective of comprehensive knowledge & skills acquisition for delivering the nursing process. Teaching for theory was done virtually with prerecorded Video-lecture, PowerPoint Presentation, Pdf. asynchronous & synchronous discussion and demonstration of procedures were done face to face in the skill lab. The final assessment was performed by a self-structured knowledge questionnaire and a practicum exa mination through OSCE in the laboratory.The result shows that students scored mean knowledge of 15.2 out of 20 with a standard deviation of 2.6 and a practice score of 9.42 out of 12 with a standard deviation of 3.1.If the pedagogy is engaging, from simple to complex, and the whole process is accompanied by self-learning material on computers, the nursing process can be made easier. Students' critical thinking and synthesizing abilities have been boosted by classroom activities. This course has provided students with the opportunity to self-learning with computers so that they can use that knowledge to improve nursing services in the future.

articleTitle: A Review of Available Standard Dataset for Automated Medicine Pill Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In this paper, we’ll review available standard datasets for automated medicine pill recognition technology. A process whereupon a dataset people discover or provide highly creative technique and tools for sorting and ranking consumer photos of prescription pills. To the need for healthcare providers and the general public to quickly identify unknown prescription medications all of these databases or datasets were created in response. Most of the prescription pills come in blister, alu-alu containers, or Ziploc packs. After unpacking the medical drugs, it is a very difficult tasks for a patient as well as professional medical staff to differentiate between them due to the lack of variability in size, shape, and color though it is a daily task for all of them. Often it is the case that label of the pack is somehow damaged, and for those how to have to take more than one medication at a time it is difficult to differentiate and find the right one between one and another from where the label is me deface or several pills are mistakenly come down from required containers. This error prone nature of the task as many of the pills have almost similar features, increases the medication error which sometimes appears as fatal for patients. The complications are even worse for elderly people with low vision and visually challenged people are at risk because they are not able to identify the color of the text printed on the pill.

articleTitle: A system for multimedia data retrieval using imagecolour feature
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Nowadays video data mining plays an important role in information retrieval process. Creation of motion image information is simple for many users. From this, retrieving the needed content especially the unstructured data sets is a complex task. Various reasons pertaining to this complexity may be due to videos taken by unprofessional people, poor camera, light and much more. Number of algorithms had been proposed to retrieve effective video content, but none of them produced expected results. It still continues to be the most challenging field for researchers. In this paper, a new video image extraction technique with the help of image feature value is proposed. Initially, the image is grouped from which, unwanted image frames are removed using the image input extract feature for specified information. Experimental outcomes prove that the suggested method is good for all types of motion images.

articleTitle: A Review on Breast Imaging Modalities based on Technical Aspects
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Most common invasive cancer in female is Breast cancer and rarely, it will be affected in men also. From the several studies found that the second leading cause of cancer death is breast cancer in women after lung cancer. The Breast cancer occurs when the cells in the breast grow and divide that cell in an uncontrolled way. Due to this cell creating a mass of tissue in the breast itself is called tumor or mass. Signs of breast cancer are seeing changes of skin on a breast, feeling a lump in a breast and size change of breast etc. If the breast cancer/ mass detected at the early stage or at initial stage, then the survival rate of patient will be improved. In this review, several modalities have been introduced to detect the breast cancer. Furthermore some of the output parameters of these modalities have been investigated. Based on various imaging modalities, were selected around 40 articles by using search engines. And studied the selected papers thoroughly and categorize the results based on modalities which have been used. The used Breast cancer imaging techniques are Mammography, Ultrasound, CT scan, MRI and PET scan etc. The modality selection has been completely depends on the patient’s like current state of cancer tissue and density, age of the patient etc.

articleTitle: An improved cryptographic technique using homomorphic transform
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The current time has seen a major boom in the digitalization of information over various platforms varying from the web, applications, internet, and portals. The digitalization of the banking domain, telemedicine, cryptocurrency, and social media has put personal information at high risk. The data of anyone can be retrieved by many methods, such as brute force and cryptographic analysis can be used to retrieve the message and key. This has led to the need for data security, requiring the information more and more secure with the improvised form of existing technology so such kinds of attacks can be avoided. In this work, an efficient cryptographic approach is proposed which can protect the text message. Results show that for various file sizes ranging from 2.5 MB to 23.3 MB the proposed approach gives a minimum of 54% improvement compared to AES. The execution time of the proposed algorithm is better than available algorithms like DES, 3DES, AES, Blowfish, and RSA, below 1 MB data size. The limitation is felt when the data size is beyond 1 MB data size as the algorithm takes a longer execution time.

articleTitle: On Strong Proper Connected Coloring of Generalised Friendship Graphs
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In an edge colored graph, a proper path is a path with two neighboring edges acquire unlike colors. Strongly proper connected graph (SPCG) is a connected graph with the property that a shortest proper path is present between any pair of vertices. The minimum number of colors needed for strongly proper connected graph is the proper connection number which is strong (SPCN). In this paper SPCN of generalised friendship graphs have been investigated.

articleTitle: A proposal for power reduction of novel SRAM cells for low power applications using Stacking Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Compact devices are emerging nowadays, so low power consumption is very important in the large memory cell design. This paper presents a novel approach on the power reduction techniques of SRAM cells for low power applications using Fin-FET technology. The optimized power reduction technique is used to reduce the leakage power. Memories are the heart of any digital system and the digital system can’t be implemented without memories. Compact devices are emerging now-a-days, so low power consumption is very important in the large memory cell design.8T Fin-FET SRAM has been analyzed using SG and Low Power-IG mode for leakage power and stability issues. The Low Power-Independent Gate mode is used to increase the stability and performance of the circuit. LSVL, USVL and mixed techniques have been compared and mixed technique is used to decrease leakage power. The leakage power is improved using LP-IG Fin-FET than SG 8T-Fin-FET SRAM and among LSVL, USVL and mixed model, the mixed model leakage power is less. It’s better to use an improved version of LECTOR technique with one extra PMOS transistor, which helps in a further reduction of leakage current. This paper focuses on the analysis in terms of special types of SRAM cell design to satisfy low power, high performance.

articleTitle: MMD labeling of some graph families
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Let the graph G has r vertices and let g be a relation from V(G) to {1,2,…,r} so that each vertex takes exactly one value i, 1 ≤ i ≤ r which is both one to one and onto. Let g* be a function induces edge labeling from E(G) to {0,1,…r-1}defined as g*(wv)=g(w)g(v)(mod r), for every edge vw in G. Collecting all edge labels and finding their addition if it is the divisor of r then the graph G is a modular multiplicative divisor (MMD) graph. Here constructed larger families of MMD graph and discuss MMD labeling of join of two graphs, one of the graph operations and complete tripartite MMD graphs. Discuss related open problems.

articleTitle: Uncooled Thermal Image Denoising using Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Thermal imaging which initially originated for military applications owing to the fact that it can produce a clear image on darkest nights as they need no light to operate thus allow seeing without being seen. Thermal imaging cameras can also see to some extent through snow, rain, fog and therefore find its application in thermal weapon sight, night vision for tanks and surveillance. However images captured are contaminated by noise during image acquisition, compression and transmission which can severely hamper successful image analysis and tracking. In this work we used a denoising convolutional neural network to reduce Gaussian noise from the images acquired through uncooled thermal imagers. From the acquired images, 100 images were segmented into patches to train the network which resulted into improved image quality metrics which are indicated through experimental results resulting into higher peak signal-to-noise ratio.

articleTitle: A Review of High-Gain Bidirectional DC-DC converter with reduced ripple current
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Recently, bidirectional dc-dc converters have gained significant attention due to the growing demand for systems that can transfer energy between two dc buses in a bidirectional manner. The converter is used in various applications like energy storage systems, UPS, EV, and RES. The aim of the paper presents a comparative review of high gain bidirectional dc to dc converter topologies. These converters are studied under the step-up and step-down mode operation. The use of coupled inductor in the converter decreases the current ripples. Finally, a comparison of the converter is done based on the ripple current and voltage gain.

articleTitle: Brain Storm Optimization based directional sensors deployment for coverage of targets
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Sensors are used in various areas and have numerous applications including military surveillance, weather monitoring, maritime communication etc. Most of the applications need the multimedia sensors with directional sensing range of the sensors to perform advance task. Additionally, there are some constraints on the targets namely Q-constraints, such that each target must be covered by different number of sensors. The crucial issue in this case is deployment of minimum number of multimedia sensors to satisfy the Q-constraints. The optimization of the placement of the sensors can result in reduced number of sensors needed for the coverage of the specified targets. In this paper, the placement of the sensors is optimized using the Brain Storm Optimization Algorithm (BSO) which is inspired by the human brainstorming process. BSO algorithm efficiently designed for the considered problem to identify the optimal position of the sensors. The performance of the proposed algorithm is verified by simulation results, which performs better than the random deployment of the sensors.

articleTitle: Age & Gender Recognition Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Human face image analysis is an important area of research in the science of computer vision. The human face conveys a wealth of information about their particular qualities. One of the most essential challenges in computer vision is recognising a person’s gender and age from a facial picture. The most significant characteristics derived from human faces are the eyes, nose, mouth, brows, and so on. These characteristics are employed in a variety of Human-Computer Interaction sectors, including security systems, judicial systems, transportation, medical, and many more. The first stage of age and gender recognition is detecting face from the inputted image. There are different techniques for face detection. The next stage is pre-processing where cropping and resizing of image for fast processing the last stage is feature extraction and classification by using deep convolution network. The various methods involved in these stages are studied and from the study building an Age and Gender Recognition System using deep learning.

articleTitle: Design of Secured Lightweight PRNG Circuit using LFSR for Portable IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: This paper proposes the pseudo random number generator (PRNG) circuit with three linear feedback shift register (LFSR) design, which generates cryptographically more secured pseudo random number than a conventional LFSR system. In this configuration, the three different LFSRs (4, 5 and 7-bit) are triggered with same positive edged clock pulse. A 1-bit comparator is employed as intermediate stage to compare the outputs of 4 and 5-bit LFSRs. The subsequent output of the 1-bit comparator has been XORed with the feedback XOR output of the 7-bit LFSR. This introduces the desired inequality in recurrence relations of the three LFSRs used to enhance the overall linear complexity of the proposed LFSR circuit. The power consumption of the proposed compact LFSR circuit is less than the conventional 16-bit LFSR.

articleTitle: A comparative study on Driver Distraction Detection using a Deep Learning model
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Numbers of road accidents are getting increased across the world due to the irresponsible behavior of drivers. To prevent the road accidents as well as to alert the drivers with proper message definitely reduce the chances of accidents. This paper designed a driver activities detection system while driving. To accomplish the task, this paper made an attempt to design driver activities classification framework upon pre-trained image classification framework. To obtain better framework, CNN,VGG16,AlexNet and LeNet frameworks preferred and customized with different hyper parameters. The designed framework is tested with the publically available dataset. The experiment results say that Framework obtained through LeNet produces the better results than that of the others.

articleTitle: The Use of Privacy-Preserving Techniques in Edge-Cloud Computing: A Study of Alternative Approaches to Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Face verification is by far the most popular biometrics technology used for authentication since it is noninvasive and does not require the assistance of the user. In contrast, fingerprint and iris identification technologies require the help of a user during the identification process. Now the technology behind facial recognition has been around for years but recently as its grown more sophisticated is applications have expanded greatly. These days a third-party service provider is often hired to perform facial recognition. The sensitivity of face data raises important privacy concerns about outsourcing servers. In order to protect the privacy of users, this paper discusses privacy-preserving face recognition frameworks applied to different networks. In this survey, we focused primarily on the accuracy of face recognition, computation time, and algorithmic approaches to face recognition on edge and cloud-based networks.

articleTitle: Character Segmentation on Indian Vehicle License Plate using K-means, OTSU and Niblack algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Automatic License Plate Recognition (ALPR) is a growing research area as with the increase in the number of vehicles, requirements for high accuracy ALPR systems are increasing as it has been extensively used for automatic road tax collection, monitor unlike activities etc. Character segmentation is a major step in the ALPR system. This paper includes the use of image pre-processing techniques, K-means clustering, Otsu and Niblack method and Connected Component Analysis (CCA) to perform character segmentation. Unlike existing works which are based on license plates of other countries and therefore may not perform well on Indian license plates, in this work we have dealt with Indian license plates. Many of the existing works are based on license plates that are captured from a straight angle and good illumination and hence may not perform well if the images of license plates have noises or are captured at different angles. Therefore, in this work we have used license plates which are at different angles with different lighting conditions.

articleTitle: Two Stage Power Conversion For Grid Connected PV Using Current Control Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In this paper, the analysis and simulation of grid connected two stage PV system using inverter and its related controller is presented. A MATLAB SIMULINK based model is developed for the grid connected two stage PV-system using inverter. From the PV panel maximum power needs to be drawn and injected to the grid in a grid connected photovoltaic system. Different MPPT topologies and control methods are available in literature. By using the Perturb and Observe MPPT algorithm in this paper, from the photovoltaic panel maximum power is obtained. To the inverter from the photovoltaic module, a DC input voltage is fed and a controlled AC output power is obtained by adjusting Id and Iq. The results obtained confirm controller performance is adequate under varying solar irradiance.

articleTitle: Wind Turbine Instrumentation System using Labview
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: This work proposes an electronics circuit-based monitoring and control panel for wind turbines. In the wind business, wind turbine monitoring is a critical task. This work describes the process of building a monitoring and control panel system that uses LabVIEW to record and analyze various metrics such as wind speed, wind direction, tip speed ratio, energy generated, power and current power using LabVIEW and buzzer indication. The measuring equipment must function properly in order to produce the highly qualified data required for an accurate wind gust prediction. This work aims to create a promising measuring and monitoring system for wind parameter measurement. The graphical user interface makes even the most critical processes much easier to control and monitor.

articleTitle: Generation and Implementation of Random Number Architecture using Difference Expansion for Digital Circuits
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Unified logic and very large-scale integration (VLSI) circuitry have been created to generate random numbers from various distributions such as uniform, exponential, and Gauss distributions. An arithmetic iteration notion is used to implement several architectural levels in the proposed system. Fast speed, low power consumption, and great output accuracy make this random number generator ideal for communications systems and other models that need multi-distribution random numbers. The difference expansion approach and linear feedback shift register (LFSR) bit switching are recommended to generate random numbers. Besides this, the randomization is unpredictably random. Predictable binary sequences have been a major drawback of earlier randomization approaches. Differential characteristics construct the sequence and keep things simple in this technique. It also aims to simplify the circuit and use less energy. Power, delay, and a lookup table are used to make performance comparisons. The proposed architecture was tested and evaluated using Xilinx. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed model outperforms standard random generators using Slices, Area, and Look Up Tables. According to the research findings, the proposed Difference Expansion-based Random Generation (DERG) has reduced latency and consumes less power.

articleTitle: Simulation of High Efficiency Switched Reluctance Motor (SRM) Drive Control Scheme by Alternate Rotation Motor Firing
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The general trend seen in the modern electrical industry is an increased adoption of reluctance machines. These devices offer performance rivaling other designs like induction and permanent magnet while having efficiency and cost advantages. Due to their lack of need for permanent magnets and rotor circuits, these machines are a prime choice for applications with sustainability in mind. Rare earth mining is not needed for these machines and the lack of rotor circuitry allows for higher efficiency and durability. The lack of mainstream adoption until recently has been needed for a complex drive circuitry, which is now being solved using lowered computation costs and advances in solid-state electronics. To explore the possibility of an efficient and novel motor drive design, the simulation of a three-phase 6/4 60kW switched reluctance motor (SRM) drive is designed to make the motor go into free-wheeling operation once every two rotations. The proposed system operation was compared with the regular motor operation to validate the benefit of increased efficiency.

articleTitle: Design of Synchronous NoC for High Speed Multiprocessor Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: As technology advances, processors are scale down size by reducing channel length. However, number of issues raises by scaling down of channel length. Network on Chip (NoC) is the supported communication protocol for System on Chip (SoC) and provides parallel communication among processing elements (PEs). Designing of synchronous NoC is quite complex as different parameters such as unbalanced traffic, buffer utilization affect the performance. This paper proposes an intra-inter buffer structure to support unbalance traffic. The proposed NoC router is able to configure channel dynamically depends on traffic conditions hence avoiding of Head of Line (HoL) error for data packet. The proposed NoC router is achieved approximately 45% more operating frequency when compared to traditional router.

articleTitle: Attendance Management System using Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In this digital world with the prevalence and advance in technology, there has been a shift toward digital education. What seemed to be a move out of necessity has now become common practice. Despite the advancement in technologies, most teachers still rely on primitive methods such as calling out students’ names to take their attendance. This is usually a tedious and time- consuming process and results in the wastage of precious class hours which can be better put to use in teaching. To replace this conventional method, we have created an automatic attendance management system. This automatic attendance management system is primarily based on facial recognition technology. Using facial recognition technology, the attendance of students can be taken in a simple and efficient user-friendly manner with little to no time wasted compared to the conventional method. Authentication is an important feature of face recognition. Common difficulties, such as student proxies and students being tagged present despite not being physically there, can be avoided by employing this structure. In this system, the students have to verify their physical presence by showing their faces to the camera. Once the camera recognizes the student it then automatically updates the attendance status of the student in the database. The attendance report will be made available after the validation of all the students from a particular class. We would aim to provide accurate results to the highest extent possible so that the system maintains its integrity and accuracy and can be trusted by all.

articleTitle: Parameters Analysis of Air with Modified Critic Method
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: With the rise in the urbanization because of the increase in the needs and demands of the people for their better livelihood and for the dream of living a luxurious life, people are continuously trying to modify or change the environment according to their needs but each thing has a limit and these limitless changes create a negative impact not only on our pocket but also affect the environment and the health negatively and Air Pollution is one of the disastrous effects of these modifications/changes with the environment which will eventually lead to an increase in the mortality rate. Most of the pollutants present in the air contribute majorly to causing many diseases related to respiration, nervous dysfunctions as well as skin-related diseases. With the constant deterioration in the quality of air due to the number of the toxic pollutants present in it like PM 10, N02, NH2, SO2, CO & Ozone, there is an immediate need to analyze the pollutants which are responsible for causing this pollution with the help of mathematical methodology. In this study, we analyze the pollutants proportion in affecting the environment and causing air pollution with the help of the Modified Critic Method of Multi-Criteria Decision Making Methods, and then a case study is done based on the Delhi state so that people are aware of the ruckus caused by them which not only harm others but themselves too and government can take immediate and proper steps for this major issue by identifying the major contribution of the pollutants so that the pollutant which pollutes the air more will be handle first accordingly.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of gait patterns in Hip Surgery Patients and Normal Subjects
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Hip surgeries for fractures are performed to move the broken bones and fix it in the right place. The gait patterns of the patients are altered after the surgery, but as they recover, the gait patterns belongs normal. Currently the recovery of gait is tracked visually. But there are certain factors that cannot be seen visually. Thus, a quantified method is a necessity to track recovery so that the right rehabilitation can be given to the patient at the right time. Analyzing gait parameters serves the purpose. This comparative study focuses on the gait patterns of intertrochanteric fracture patients and normal subjects so that a comparative analysis can be done on how much the patients are deviated from the normal gait and track their improvement over a period of time.

articleTitle: Comparison of Swarm Optimization Algorithms for Multi-Target Tracking and Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Nowadays the tracking and detection of different objects are important. One of the major applications where we commonly use both of these are the surveillance applications. Here the fastness and the accuracy are very much important and based on those things the technology is searching for new ideas or methods. Most of the algorithms for target detection are currently based on neural networks. The commonly used methods for selecting appropriate hyper-parameters are the random search and grid search methods. But those algorithms have a lot of disadvantages and that makes them inefficient and inaccurate. So, for avoiding those disadvantages we are considering optimization algorithms with swarm intelligence. There are different swarm optimization algorithms, in which the most efficient one is the Glow worm Swarm Optimization (GSO) algorithm. This algorithm will give fast and accurate tracking and detection of objects. We are going to analyze the applicability of the GSO algorithm for the tracking and detection of several moving and stationary targets at the same time and compare other swarm optimization algorithms on the basis of multi-target tracking and detection.

articleTitle: Forecasting of weld parameters by soft computing techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Tensile strength and hardness are typically used to determine the quality of a weld. The work is concerned with the development of soft computing models to map the relationship between the input welding factors and responses. Soft computing techniques like ANN, fuzzy logic, and ANFIS are used to predict responses such as UTS and hardness. Finally, confirmatory experiments are used for validation of all developed models.

articleTitle: Modelling an Adaptive Clustering Model for the Mining Community Using Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Data clustering is a crucial phase in data analysis, widely concentrated by data mining communities. Many previous algorithms based on data clustering are related to the endless models that look for sparsity and higher dimensional issues and try to avoid the sequence of information and the data structural data. The recurrent and convolutional neural networks work on deep learning-based models concerning the data as sequences. Yet, the explanation of outcomes and the supervised signals are lacking. The adaptive data clustering model (ADCM) technique is proposed in this system to incorporate the pre-trained data encoders into data clustering tasks. This model depends on the representation of a sequence that breaks the dependencies on the supervision. The proposed system provides experimental outcomes that perform better than the traditional data clustering algorithm and the modern data model, pre-trained on the complete datasets. Additionally, the clustering result explains the significant understanding of the deep learning technique principles. The clustering approach proposes the description model that assists the users in understanding the quality and meaning of the outcome of the clustering process.

articleTitle: Toilet Odour Detection Using Fuzzy Logic Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The cleanliness of the toilet is very important for human beings. Germs and bacteria start spreading on the human body from here. That is why toilets need to be sanitized and cleaned every day. You have noticed a foul smell in a school’s/college’s/public restroom. It is always a challenge to keep toilets clean because even with frequent, diligent cleaning, odours can persist. It takes special, precise methods and products to prevent school/college toilets from becoming problems. To overcome this, an Arduino-based device to detect bad odors. Device consists of an odour-detecting sensor (humidity sensor, odour sensor, electronic nose) that detects bad odours and informs authorities through SMS (using interface GSM module) and phone call (using PSR module). The device can be mounted on the wall of a toilet. By using this device, students can stay healthy. Additionally, it may reduce some unpleasant diseases. Also, the management is able to reduce the manpoitr and call workers when needed

articleTitle: COVID Prevention Protocol with Attendance Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Coronaviruses, a large family of distinct viruses, have recently become exceedingly prevalent, communicable, and harmful to the entire human race. It transmits from person to person by exhaling infected breath, which deposits virus droplets on various surfaces, which are subsequently inhaled by another person, who contracts the infection. As a result, we must safeguard ourselves and those around us from this predicament. You can take safety measures such as keeping a social distance, washing your hands every two hours, using disinfectants, and most importantly, wearing a mask. In recent years, wearing masks in public places has become widespread all over the world. As an attendance system is a mandatory part in every school, college and workplace we can utilize it to follow some standard covid prevention protocol. The paper’s goal is to create a system with covid preventive protocol along with the attendance management system. The covid preventive protocol includes Detection of the mask, Temperature Monitoring, and sanitization. To identify whether the face mask is present or not, CNN a deep learning algorithm is used with the help of python code. My CNN model achieves better accuracy than Alexnet and LeNet which are the predefined framework of convolutional neural network.

articleTitle: Medicine assistance application for visually impaired people
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Visual written information nowadays is the basis for most of the tasks but for visually impaired people reading printed text is a challenging task. Nowadays smartphones are very common and accessible to each and everyone. The objective of this project is to assist visually challenged elderly people in taking correct and timely doses of medicines without being dependent on others using their smartphones. Users need to take pictures of the backside of medicine strips with the help of their mobile camera in the app. The application will scan the text written on it with the help of optical character recognition (OCR) and with the help of text localization techniques it will extract medicine details from the wrapper of medicine. App also allows users to set reminders to take dosage of their medicine on time. This project is proposed to help visually challenged people with the help of Artificial intelligence, machine learning, image to text recognition and voice assistance.

articleTitle: An Efficient Algorithm to Recommend Covid-19 Related Solutions
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: With the rise of Covid-19, the open-source community has devoted a huge amount of time into developing technical solutions to stop the spread of the virus. Useful solutions like symptom trackers and extensive analysis on existing datasets are a small drop in the massive number of solutions developed by people. But with the massive number of projects or solutions, it is time consuming for a motivated person to find an appropriate solution to put his time into. Therefore, seeing the inspiring amount of work done by the open source community, we are suggesting an efficient algorithm to recommend projects that are Coronavirus related to which the user can get recommendations for projects according to their preference such as language.

articleTitle: Prevention of School Shooting using Neural Networks and Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The main goal of the project is to focus on resolving the major threat or problem of school shootings by developing a system that provides the best security within schools and avoid any threat that may arise. The project is planned such a way that it uses advanced concepts such as Deep Neural Networks which would allow facial recognition of the students and teachers and therefore permit them into the school campuses based on certain conditions where the person should not carry harmful weapons or anything that would cause a threat to the children. Deep Neural Networks using algorithms like YOLOv3 can be used to identify the person that could carry harmful weapons, and other color detection algorithms to distinguish dress color. Computer Vision plays a major role in weapon detection and thus, ensures the safety within the school premises. Further, features like buzzers and alert notifications can be used to alert the students and the higher authorities and also the nearest police department. the images of the suspects can be taken and directed to the commissioners for further actions.

articleTitle: Utilization of Small Sized SMES for Wind disturbance In Wind Penetrated Power
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: An active power loop configured on synthetic inertia present in doubly fed induction generator is considered in his study. To make the power system pragmatic constraints like governor deadband and steam reheat constraints are taken into account. A compact sized Superconducting Magnetic energy storage device is designed and integrated to the wind penetrated power system by using level one S function coding in Matlab simulink environment To make the scheme effective the proportional and integral gains of the system are tuned using the global optimization tool genetic algorithm. A wind disturbance is introduced in the system. It is observed the compact sized SMES device coupled with synthetic inertia present in Wind turbine generators is effective in arresting the frequency and tie-power deviations of the power system.

Author Keywords: (PCS) Power conditioning system voltage source converter (VSC)

articleTitle: An Improvised Voter Architecture For TMR With Reduced Area Overhead
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The introduction of nanoscale technology causes device shrinkage, making them more vulnerable to radiation-induced effects. These radiation-induced effects are crucial in mission-critical applications such as spacecraft and nuclear power plants. In FPGAs, Triple Modular Redundancy (TMR), a 3-tuple form of N-modular redundancy, is utilized to counteract these effects. TMR duplicates the original simplex system, and the majority voter ensures that two out of three systems remain operational to provide the correct output, presuming that the voter does not fail. Several voters in the literature overcome the drawbacks of the classical voter, and approximates of the conventional system can replace two of the three systems to reduce the 200 percent area overhead. In this paper, we propose a mux-based voter circuit whose input is the approximate TMR system’s output, resulting in improved fault-masking with less area and power consumption. The circuits are simulated using the Cadence 45nm CMOS process, and the results are analysed.

articleTitle: Improved Block Compressive Sensing Methods using the Modified Iterative BCS-FOCUSS
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Compressing the digital images is an essential task for saving bandwidth of the transmission. But recovery of compressed images is an open challenging task in hand. Block Compressive Sensing (BCS) is widely used for the recovery of compressed methods. Usually independent BCS method is in efficient for image recovery thus, it is used in combination of the smooth projection based Landwebers and collaboratively method is called as BCS-SPL. In order to improve performance in this paper a collaborative approach is proposed using the BCS-SPL and the BCS-FOCUSS algorithms. The method is implemented in the different wavelet and DCT based transformation domains. Proposed method uses the modified iterative BCS-FOCUSS method for performance improvement. The performance of the proposed method is tested over wide range of unique ranges. The parametric evaluation of the PSNR and SSIM, performance showed the significantly improved with proposed modifications.

articleTitle: Financial and Individual Future Expense Prediction Based on Frequent Patterns Using Micro Services
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Consumers have a wealth of offerings and productive alternatives to choose from in today's world. As a result, people's prices have skyrocketed in contrast to a decade before, and the cost of living continues to rise every day. Therefore, to lead a fantastic lifestyle with the correct price range set up, it will become necessary to keep a close eye on costs. Users can track their prices in terms of bar graphs, pie charts, and summaries on a day-to-day or weekly, or even monthly/ yearly basis with this software. The given utility is both net and cellular, a complete specified expense tracker device with a view to no longer only help users maintain a take a look at their fees, but additionally cut down the unrequited fees, and as a result, will help offer a responsible way of life. An evaluation comparing the current price tracker and the existing tracker applications was established. The mobile application was created to help users keep track of their expenses and decide whether they are spending within their budget. While the expense was created, potential users needed to enter the desired information, including the price amount, service provider, category, and date. Optional records, such as sub-classes and additional rate remarks, can also be entered. A monitoring software program with the one being added is provided. Penny, the Expense Tracker.

articleTitle: Comparison of Segmentation Techniques for Skin Cancer Detection in dermoscopic images
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Lately, one of the most common forms of cancer is Skin cancer and is not necessarily the easiest to identify. But with the introduction of computer aided diagnosis or CAD, the observation and the classification of suspicious lesion has become uncomplicated. In this paper, we proposed an approach to segment and compare the classification results of the dermoscopic images. The images are taken from PH2 dataset and the 2 segmentation techniques used are Region Growing and Watershed. The textural features are drawn namely GLCM, GLRLM and Statistical. The classification is done using Complex tree, Fine KNN and Boosted Trees. The results show that the watershed technique performed comparatively better than the Region Growing. The former showed 100% accuracy for KNN, 85.5% for decision tree and 50.5% for ensemble. The Area under ROC curve (AUC) for all the classifiers is 1, 1 and 1 consecutively. However the latter presented 100% accuracy for KNN, 49% for decision tree and only 4% for ensemble. The AUC calculated is 1, 0.9 and 0.5 consecutively.

articleTitle: Analysis of Total Harmonic Distortion of Three-Phase Induction Motor Drive for Different PWM Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Over the past few decades, induction motor has become a reliable choice in the industrial field as an electromechanical device. The inherent characteristics of an induction motor make it convenient, efficient and popular option among industrial applications. With the development of power electronic devices and power converters, it has become possible to control the speed of induction motor smoothly. Although these converters are capable of providing more flexible speed control, they also cause some technical hitches such as distorted current and voltage waveforms, increasing losses, pulsating torque etc. These are mainly due to harmonic contents added in voltage and current waveforms. Therefore, it is necessary to analyze such problems while designing efficient electric drive. This paper mainly deals with an investigation and analysis of harmonic profile executed by three-phase voltage source inverter for different PWM using Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) through MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Ramanujan Sums-Wavelet Transform: A New Approach to Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Ramanujan Sum is a trigonometric summation introduced by Srinivasa Ramanujan in 1918. Recently, this summation technique is widely used in digital signal processing applications like pattern recognition, feature extraction, signal analysis, image compression, etc. Ramanujan Sums-Wavelet Transform (RSWT) is a signal analysis tool introduced by Chen et al. in 2013, in which the multiresolution representation nature of the wavelet transform and the energy conservation property of the Ramanujan Sums transform are blended to extract more useful information from the signal. Ordinary wavelet transform can be obtained as a special case of RSWT and hence it provides us with a multitude of ways to analyze signals under consideration. In this paper, we discuss RSWT in one-dimensional signal analysis, especially in time series analysis.

articleTitle: Design and development of the main drive circuit of a PMSM based floating waste collecting electric vehicle for marine ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: One of the most urgent concerns people face today is water contamination. The most common source of water pollution is the disposal of plastic garbage in bodies of water. As a result, both humans and aquatic ecosystems may suffer. It’s past time to deal with the current problem. This paper proposes to design, model and analysis of the main drive circuit for a low-cost, floating waste-collection Electric Vehicle for marine ecology.A Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine (PMSM) was chosen for the system. A PV array is used to power the system, through a Voltage Source Inverter. The inverter switching pulses are generated using the Space Vector Pulse Width Modulation (SVPWM) Technique.The input voltage obtained from the solar PV panel is regulated using a DC-DC Boost converter. To operate the system at the maximum power point, the Perturb and Observe (P&O) approach of Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) is applied. The drive circuit was simulated using MATLAB/Simulink and its performance is examined under various operating conditions by altering the load torque, radiance, and temperature of the PV array.

articleTitle: Communication Technologies in IoT and Related Concepts: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Communication has become a significant part of today’s world. With the escalating number of advancements in the field of the Internet of Things (IoT) and related notions like cyber-physical systems (CPS), Industry 4.0, and Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), the need for efficient communication arises. Depending on the distance required for the application and the quality of transmission, there are multiple communication protocols that can be utilized. Various technologies that are used for communication in IoT devices are discussed and compared in this paper. Other related concepts mentioned above are introduced and briefed. Since more and more institutions are starting to adopt technologies from IoT and advanced manufacturing features from IIoT as a part of their systems, these notions are no more an extravagance but are a requirement. The personalization aspect of IoT is what draws businesses and organizations to equip their products with its technologies. This in turn raised questions related to data security. The purpose of this paper is to introduce the notions, compare how various enabling technologies are used to help devices communicate, and discuss the possible attacks in systems involving them.

articleTitle: National Travelling Salesman Problem for Indian Cities: a Case Study
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: National traveling salesman problem (NTSP) is the subset of the World traveling salesman problem. NTSP has solved for twenty-six countries not of the country India. In the national traveling salesman problem, the user has to travel all the cities without revisiting the visited city of the given country. In this paper, the NTSP is solved for the Indian cities using the genetic algorithm, artificial neural network self-organizing map (SOM), and Simulated Annealing (SA). The early results show that the self-organizing map is an efficient method than the genetic algorithm and simulated annealing. But if the input is noisy then the genetic algorithm and simulated annealing perform better than the self-organizing map.

articleTitle: SMS Based Remote Mobile Phone Data Access System
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Presently cellphone and other cellular gadgets have emerged as one of the inevitable component in every aspect of our existence. Mobile phones are an effective communication tool that can make life easier. It allows to send and receive messages, connect with people in any part of the world with high reliability and security. Mobile tool safety is an essential element that secures all of the sensitive information of the consumer stored on the device. The proposed system,SMS Based Remote Mobile Phone Data Access System allows the user to perform major operations without using internet, with high security. The venture aims to develop a cell protection machine as a way to allow consumer to perform various operations such as, obtain contact details from mobile device for remote user, change the profile, track the location and lock the mobile phone via SMS.

articleTitle: Application of Principal Component Analysis (PCA) in Random Wind Generation with singular covariance matrix
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: This paper suggests two methods to handle wide input matrices to generate random winds. Both the methods are making the input matrix tall by choosing wind measurements at specific altitudes from all the measured data and excluding the measurements at remaining altitudes. Both are reducing the variable (zonal or meridional wind components at various altitudes) dimension in different way. Subsequently, Choleskey decomposition is used to generate random winds corresponding to the dimensionally reduced system. First method, named as - MTBRS (Making Tall By Random Selection), fixes the specific altitudes randomly. The second one, named as, MTBPCA (Making Tall By PCA) uses Principal Component Analysis (PCA) concept to reduce the dimension of the system.

articleTitle: Effect of U-Net Hyperparameter Optimisation in Polyp Segmentation from Colonoscopy Images
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Colorectal cancer can be detected from the location of polyps present in the colon. Colonoscopy is the standard method for polyp detection from where the images are retrieved. Deep neural networks are preferred for the segmentation of polyps from colonoscopy images. The hyperparameters directly control the performance of the neural network model. In this work, the impacts of different neural network optimizers and various activation functions are analyzed for U-net architecture. The analysis shows that the N- Adam optimizer with Sigmoid activation function yields better accuracy of 94.06% for polyp segmentation from colonoscopy images.

articleTitle: Design and Development of I-Shaped Structure Antenna for Wireless Communications
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In this work, an I-shaped microstrip patch antenna with excellent bandwidth and gain for various wireless applications is proposed. The suggested structure would span the frequency range of I-Shaped microstrip patch antennas, which is 2 GHz to 11 GHz. The suggested antenna, made of FR4 and having a dielectric constant of 2.4, is powered by a microstrip line. Radar, satellite communication, medical applications, remote sensing, wireless communication, and other applications may all benefit from this antenna. In order to increase transmission and reception, a gadget needs an antenna. It will also use less energy, be more efficient, and last longer. The suggested I-patch antenna has lower return losses at resonance frequencies of 2 GHz and 11 GHz, which makes it suitable for GPS and other band applications. The bandwidth of the first resonating frequency is 2 GHz, while the bandwidth of the second is 11 GHz. Performance metrics for the recommended antenna include return loss, VSWR, radiation pattern, and directivity. The HFSS programme is used to design and test antennas.

articleTitle: Comparison Between TCP, MPTCP, MPTCP-TSC & ReMP TCP
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In modern days devices are able to connect with more than one interfaces at a time which ensures seamless connectivity. MPTCP maintains the two or more route concurrently between sender and receiver and give seamless connectivity without any interruption. On the other hand traditional routing is not effective and sometimes not even feasible in some cases due to infrastructure setup. In order to overcome the traditional routing limitations, and to increase the capacity of current dynamic diverse wireless networks, the opportunistic routing model has been proposed in this paper. The main goal of this paper is to show the characteristics comparison between different transport layer protocol like TCP, MPTCP, MPTCP-TSC and ReMP TCP under MATLAB framework.

articleTitle: Implementation of Regime-5 Posit adder
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Posit is the alternative representation of real numbers. The advantage of posit compared to floating-point format is increase in dynamic range and it overcomes the overflow, underflow, NaN (Not a Number) problems in floating-point number representation. In this paper, posit adders are proposed with 5 bit of constant regime width and compared with single precision floating-Point adders. This variation in regime bit changes the dynamic range and precision. The implementation of posit adder with Regime-5 decreases the area by 23%, delay by 36%. The power has been lowered by more than half. The precision of regime-5 is great, but the dynamic range is limited.

articleTitle: Detection of Brain Tumor & Intra-Tumoral Structures from the Brain MR Images
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Discovering the brain tumor and Intra-Tumoral structures from the brain tumor MR images is an essential task in tumor diagnostics. An automated system that accurately detects the brain tumor and intra-Tumoral structure from MR images will help the patients with a speedy recovery. It also reduces the time required for diagnosis.Detection of the brain tumor and the intra-Tumoral region is an intricate task as the structure of the tumor has different size, shape, location, and variation in intensity range. Here we have analyzed a variety of supervised and unsupervised learning techniques for the uncovering of a brain tumor and intraTumoral structures. We have designed a multistage hybrid approach using the information from different MR models such as features from individual images and features from the fused images to improve the accuracy of detecting a brain tumor and internal tumor structure from MRI images.

articleTitle: Demand Response: A Tool for Flexibility Creation in the Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Demand response is termed as encouraging consumers to voluntarily trim the electricity usage at specific times of the day. Therefore, the optimal power flow model is used to solve the problem of identifying the appropriate operating levels for electric power plants in order to meet demand across a transmission network while trying to minimize operating costs. Moreover, the cost, losses. Load, demand and line charging levels are compared using Matlab and ETAP software (Electrical Transient Analyzer Program) is used to evaluate optimal setting and have design power system operation. This article investigates OPF and load flow of an IEEE 30 bus system in Matlab and ETAP. Thereby, the result outcome generates the comparison of both Matlab and ETAP. Finally this work shows that is used to investigates a larger and practical competitive power system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Actuation Schemes for 3-PPRS Parallel Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: 3- legged PPRS (Prismatic Prismatic Rotary Spherical) parallel manipulator can be driven by two actuation schemes. The first scheme involves actuating the two PRISMATIC actuators. The second scheme consists in actuating one PRISMATIC and one ROTARY actuator—the method of actuation influences the path planning, dynamics and control of the manipulator. Hence a comparison study of both the schemes will help choose an appropriate actuation scheme. The actuation method is studied and analyzed by computing the Jacobian velocity of the manipulator and the inertia forces of the link elements. Jacobian matrix is obtained using the principle of screw theory. In comparison to scheme-2, scheme-1 gives a better performance concerning actuator velocity, dexterity and inertia forces.

articleTitle: Design of an innovative smoke sensor and fire alarm panel
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: A fire alarm system is mandatory for all nuclear and industrial establishments to protect the safety of the public, environment, and plant personnel from a plant fire and its potential effects on safe reactor operation. The system shall be provided for its rapid detection of fires and an adequate level of fire protection for structures, systems, and components important to safety. A fire that is not promptly extinguished will prevent essential plant safety functions from being performed. All the NPP(Nuclear power plants) and facilities are equipped with fire detection systems. Fire detection systems consist of thousands of fire sensors and associated electronics. Detectors need to be installed as per the design, selection, and installation criteria mentioned in the standards. This calls for procurement of thousands of various types of smoke detectors and associated electronics from private industry, which are met only from imports, as there is no established certified Indian manufacturer. Hence, there is a great need for the indigenous development of these detectors. Attempts are made, and feasibility prototypes are tested at ISS/EIG to develop smoke sensors, electronics, and communication protocols using simple techniques at throw-away costs.

articleTitle: Waste Management and Wealth Generation Through Waste Elimination
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Waste management and disposal has become a matter of concern with increasing waste products due to increase in population. There are a lot of dustbins that remain uncleaned for several days due to which there is a spread of foul smell and various diseases. Also, there are many products which can be reused but are not being reused properly, they are being discarded or burned which creates air pollution and wastage of raw materials. These raw materials can be used by the industry people and be given a new shape to it. Wealth can be generated by selling these secondary waste products. There is lack of awareness among the people regarding proper waste management and reuse of waste products. As a solution to all these problems the proposed system focuses on easy collection, cleaning of the dustbins, reusability of waste products as well as spreading of knowledge and awareness among the people.

articleTitle: Detection of hate speech in Social media memes: A comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: This work projects light upon the challenges of hate speech detection in memes and demonstrates the various machine learning model to automatically detect hate in the internet memes. Memes are the visual content shared on the social media in the form of combination of picture and some textual phrases to depict light humour or jokes. However, some images in the form of memes can also be used to convey misinformation and hate, so their early automatic detection is necessary to stop the hate spreading to wide range of users or population which may cause unrest and harm to human life and property. In this paper, the hateful meme dataset by Facebook AI has been used to test the various unimodal and a multimodal approach to baseline performance for these models and highlight the challenges these hate memes pose to the community.

articleTitle: Mutual Coupling Analysis of 2x2 MIMO Antenna Using Defected Ground Structure at Millimeter Wave
publicationTitle: 2022 Third International Conference on Intelligent Computing Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: With the introduction of 5G, the future wireless communication technology, there is a need for higher bandwidth and data rate. As the major component frequency is moving towards mm-Wave, the RF component size decreases drastically. The antenna is the major component at the interface of free space and device, which also reduces in size drastically with the increase in the operating frequency. To achieve high gain and high data rate, MIMO stands promising. With the introduction of a large number of closely spaced antennas at the transmitter and receiver, the effects of mutual coupling increase. In this paper, a 2x2 MIMO is designed, with each antenna operating at 28GHz. Mutual coupling analysis of 2x2 MIMO antenna with the complete ground and by introducing defected ground structures. The mutual coupling analysis is carried out using the ECC and diversity through s-parameters, by varying the spacing between the two-antennas from λ/2 to λ/8 with and without Defected Ground Structures, where λ is the free-space wavelength. The DGS (Defected Ground Structures) used is dumbbell-shaped with a rectangular head introduced in the ground plane. Obtained results show that with the introduction of DGS structure radiating elements can be placed at a distance of λ/8 between them which in turn reduces the overall size of antenna systems.
